subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and choose which of the statements logically follows from the conclusions.

**Statement:**

The teacher said, "Those who have attempted question number 10 will get 2 extra marks because there was a typing error in the question."

**Conclusion:**

I. Grace mark is given due to management error.

II. Those who did not attempt the question will not be getting grace marks for question number 10.
solution:
__
 
• According to the question statement, the ***typing error has led to the provision of extra marks***__ for those who have attempted the erroneous question. Thus, it can be concluded that such grace marks are provided when the management makes errors in the question paper.
 
• The statement uses the words *__**'those who' which implies that grace marks are being provided to the students who have attempted the question.**__* By definition of an exam, no mark is allotted for a question that is not attempted. Thus, we can conclude that those who haven't attempted will not be getting extra marks

Hence the correct answer is **option 3.**
